principle: Use the least expensive approved model that passes deterministic invariants for the task family. Model choice never changes permissions.
binding: Checked-in OpenCode roles omit provider/model IDs. Select or bind only locally verified approved IDs in private user or organization configuration.
escalate_when: the same invariant fails after two bounded materially different attempts
grain hierarchy ledger currency sign date or lineage semantics remain ambiguous
tool output is malformed stale or truncated
required context cannot fit without losing mandatory evidence
an unsupported schema or version prevents deterministic validation
the next action crosses a live write security or broad-impact boundary
do_not_escalate_only_because: the model can improve its task brief or load a routed reference
promotion_rule: Qualify a model per task family using synthetic evals. Require all critical invariants and zero critical policy violations; do not let the model grade itself.
